words-wait.sentence: Anything waiting on Loudon's read waits in a worktree of its own, on a branch, never in a scratch folder; it merges to main after his yes.
words-wait.claim: In one deposit (D-2026-11-04-AUDILLUSIONS), the words were written to a branch and fixed there three times within 13 minutes of being written (3 factual fixes, a cold reader's 21, a second reader's 6), then sat on the branch with no new commit for 3 days 22 h, and reached main in one merge whose message records that every word was read. The record does not show when the words were put in front of their reader.

hand: fix counts read two ways, from each commit body's own numbering and from git's numstat
hand: headless Chrome rasterises the SVG to PNG at 2x

placed-before-read.sentence: Anything waiting on Loudon's read waits in a worktree of its own, on a branch, never in a scratch folder; it merges to main after his yes.
placed-before-read.claim: In one deposit (D-2026-11-04-AUDILLUSIONS), the map's yes came as a title change, not a read of the words, so the words were placed on a branch, outside canon: written, then fixed three times (3 factual fixes, a cold reader's 21, a second reader's 6), all within 13 min 25 s. They then sat with no new commit for 3 days 22 h and reached main in one merge whose message records that every word was read. Of the 6 deposits run under v2.8 and v2.9, it is the only one placed on a branch before its read; in 4 the read came first. The record does not show when the words were put in front of their reader.
